name: audit

Runs all 15 specialist sub-agents across SEO, accessibility/interaction/layout/code defects, and UX/visual/motion/content design, then merges them into one scored report with a prioritized action plan. why_zh: 同类工具只查单点，它把15个维度合成一张评分表，且按优先级排好行动项，省掉你逐份报告的拼凑时间。
why_en: Unlike single-dimension tools, it fuses 15 audit streams into one scored, prioritized action plan—no more stitching reports.
